query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM chat_message_events e
            JOIN chat_messages m
              ON m.room_id = e.room_id
             AND m.id = e.message_id
             AND m.created_at = e.message_created_at
            WHERE e.room_id = $1
              AND e.sequence > $2
              AND e.event_type = 'chat_message_created'
              AND m.status <> $3
              AND (m.user_id IS NULL OR m.user_id <> $4)
